text: The Patriots head to Buffalo on Sunday for an AFC East showdown at Highmark Stadium with most of their roster intact—Dre'Mont Jones, Craig Woodson, and Eli Raridon return after questionable designations, and all six players listed as questionable are active for the divisional matchup—though they'll face significant defensive absences with Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore unavailable and will need to lean on Matt Pryor's addition to the offensive line. Drake Maye addressed concerns about his right shoulder this week, insisting the physical condition isn't impacting his ability to throw while acknowledging that his early struggles stem from poor decision-making rather than injury as the Patriots look to improve on their 1-2 record. Romeo Doubs, signed to a four-year deal back in March, continues searching for consistency in the offense and will get another chance to find his footing against a Bills team looking to bounce back after Josh Allen's recent sloppy performances.
